mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fixture (season_id, stage_id, group_id, knockout_tie_id, round_no, home_team_id, away_team_id, kickoff_at, venue, referee, status, home_score, away_score, home_penalty_score, away_penalty_score, data_locked, created_by) VALUES (#{seasonId}, #{stageId}, #{groupId}, #{knockoutTieId}, #{roundNo}, #{homeTeamId}, #{awayTeamId}, #{kickoffAt}, #{venue}, #{referee}, #{status}, #{homeScore}, #{awayScore}, #{homePenaltyScore}, #{awayPenaltyScore}, #{dataLocked}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fixture WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND status <> 'DRAFT' ORDER BY kickoff_at, id
SELECT * FROM fixture WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY kickoff_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE fixture SET season_id = #{seasonId}, stage_id = #{stageId}, group_id = #{groupId}, round_no = #{roundNo}, home_team_id = #{homeTeamId}, away_team_id = #{awayTeamId}, kickoff_at = #{kickoffAt}, venue = #{venue}, referee = #{referee}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE fixture SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE fixture SET home_score = #{homeScore}, away_score = #{awayScore}, home_penalty_score = #{homePenaltyScore}, away_penalty_score = #{awayPenaltyScore}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE fixture SET home_score = #{homeScore}, away_score = #{awayScore}, home_penalty_score = #{homePenaltyScore}, away_penalty_score = #{awayPenaltyScore}, status = 'FINISHED', data_locked = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE fixture SET data_locked = #{locked}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
